newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to down 0.10.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to down 0.10.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent a lb weaker Tuesday, based on market orders at 1018 EST, dealers said.
Prices closed slightly firmer Monday after bouncing above and below unchanged throughout the session, amid a dearth of fundamental news.
March settled up 0.42 cent at 76.49 cents per pound, traded 76.52 to 75.42 cents. Spot December ended up 0.45 at 75.25 cents, while the back months finished 0.03 to 0.45 firmer.
Open interest in the December contract stood at 850 lots as of Friday. December 6 is the final trading day for the contract.
There were no notices issued today. Total notices to date stand at 376.
Technically, March resistance was pegged at 76.50 cents, while support was seen near Monday's low of 75.42 cents.
